svg.text: ALA-0004 against the other five springs
Six springs above Almaty, sampled 25 October 2026. Rows are the springs in the order they were visited.

g.text: mean of three readings; axis spans the operational range
test strip; 4 of 6 read its maximum, so true values are higher
